name: apps
written: 2026-10-08, by reading each app's layout, build files and Python modules at its pinned commit (docs/north-star.json corpus and live_corpus). None of the four is pipeline-shaped software: FleetManageWeb and finance-os are React single-page apps on Supabase, chief-ops a React client with its own Node server, RendaPerene a Streamlit app over SQLite. Their build and CI chains (npm scripts, GitHub Actions) are tooling, not the product, and may be shown as such with their evidence.
